description: This Go source file implements a repository for managing project differential data in a database. It provides functions to insert differential rows, retrieve the most recent differential metadata, and fetch the latest differential details for a specific project target.

classes.name: project
classes.description: A repository class for managing project differential data, encapsulating database operations related to project differentials, including insertion and retrieval methods.

methods.name: InsertDiffRows
methods.description: Inserts multiple differential rows into the project_differential table within a single transaction.

methods.name: GetMostRecentOuterKey
methods.description: Retrieves the latest timestamp and UUID for differential data for the specified project target.

methods.name: GetMostRecentDifferentials
methods.description: Fetches the most recent differential rows corresponding to the latest recorded differential timestamp and UUID.
